PINCER_ATTACK.description: If this move is not very effective against the target, it will always be a critical hit. Otherwise, its chance of being a critical hit is as normal.

SALT_CRASH.description: 25% chance to lower the opponents' Defense. Chance of effect increases by 10% each time used in succession.

SNOWY_TERRAIN.description: Snowy Terrain creates terrain that envelops the field and replaces the background environment and any other terrain that is already in effect. The terrain fades after five turns.

MIRACLE_WILL.description: Miracle Will's effect varies depending on the target. If it targets an opponent, it deals damage. If it targets an ally, it restores up to 50% of the target's maximum HP.

CORRUPT.description: Corrupt lowers two random stats of the target by two stages each.

EARTHBREAKER.description: Earthbreaker deals damage. Unlike other Steel-type moves, it deals super-effective damage to Ground-type Pokémon, even if the user has the Normalize Ability. It can hit a Pokémon during the semi-invulnerable turn of Dig, but does not deal double damage like Earthquake.

DUST_DEVIL.description: Can hit flying and levitating Pokémon.

PERPLEX.description: Deals double damage if the target is confused.

ENGULF.description: Inflicts damage and also removes traps and hazards.

PRISM_BEAM.description: The typing of this move changes to match the user's type.

DRY_NEEDLES.description: Dry Needles inflicts damage, hitting the target 2-5 times per use. There is a 35% chance that it will hit 2 times, a 35% chance that it will hit 3 times, a 15% chance that it will hit 4 times, and a 15% chance that it will hit 5 times.

BARBED_TACKLE.description: Barbed Tackle deals damage and has a 30% chance of poisoning the target.

THORN_WHIP.description: Thorn Whip deals damage and has an increased critical hit ratio.

CACTUS_SMASH.description: Cactus Smash inflicts damage, and the user receives recoil damage equal to ⅓ of the damage done to the target. It also has a 35% chance to poison the target.

CINDER_BREATH.description: Cinder Breath deals damage and lowers the target's accuracy by one stage.

NAIL_FLICK.description: Nail Flick deals damage and has an increased Critical Hit ratio.

NOSTRIL_FLARE.description: Nostril Flare deals damage and has an increased priority.

DRACO_BLITZ.description: Draco Blitz deals damage and has a 10% chance of burning the target. The user receives recoil damage equal to ⅓ of the damage done to the target. If the user is frozen, it will thaw before using the move.

FLASH_FLOOD.description: Flash Flood deals damage and has increased priority.

FOGGY_STRIKE.description: Foggy Strike deals damage and never misses, unless the target is out of reach during a move such as Fly or Dig.

NIMBUS_FIST.description: Nimbus Fist deals damage and lowers the target's accuracy by one stage. Nimbus Fist is a punching move and will be boosted by the ability Iron Fist.

TYPHOON.description: Typhoon deals damage and has a 30% chance of lowering the target's accuracy by one stage.

TAR_TANTRUM.description: Tar-Tantrum deals damage and has a 30% chance of lowering the target's Speed by one stage. If the user is frozen and selects Tar-Tantrum as their move, they will be thawed. Tar-Tantrum is a punching move and will have its power boosted by Iron Fist.

AMBUSH.description: Ambush has increased priority and always makes the target flinch unless the target has Inner Focus or Shield Dust. However, Ambush fails unless it is used on the first turn the user enters the battle.

VENOM_SWIPE.description: Venom Swipe deals damage and has a 30% chance of poisoning the targets.

VANISH.description: Vanish raises the user's evasion by two stages.

FOCUSED_RAM.description: Focused Ram inflicts damage, and the user receives recoil damage equal to ¼ of the damage done to the target.

SEARING_SLASH.description: Searing Slash deals damage and has a 10% chance of burning the target. It has an increased critical hit ratio.

THUNDER_SLASH.description: Thunder Slash deals damage and has an increased critical hit ratio.

FAENG_RUSH.description: Faeng Rush deals damage and has a 30% chance of making the target flinch. Faeng Rush is a biting move and will have its power increased by 50% if the user has the ability Strong Jaw.

GROOM_GUARD.description: Groom Guard increases the user's Special Defense by three stages.

PRESSURIZE.description: Pressurize increases the user's Special Defense by two stages.

EEVOBOOST.description: Eevoboost raises the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by one stage each.

BONE_SWEEP.description: Bone Sweep does damage and hits both foes in a double battle.

BRAIN_FREEZE.description: Brain Freeze deals damage and has a 10% chance of freezing the target.

DECAP_ATTACK.description: Decap Attack inflicts damage, and the user receives recoil damage equal to ⅓ of the damage done to the target. Decap Attack is considered a ball/bomb move and will be blocked by Bulletproof.

COSMIC_RAY.description: Cosmic Ray deals damage and has a 15% chance of causing the target to flinch. Cosmic Ray is considered a pulse-based move and will have its power increased by 50% if the user has Mega Launcher.

DEJA_VU.description: Déjà-vu deals damage and never misses, unless the target is out of reach during a move such as Fly or Dig.

BRAIN_STORM.description: Brain Storm deals damage and has a 70% chance of raising the user's Special Attack by one stage.

ASTRAL_SHOT.description: Astral Shot deals damage and has increased priority.

COMET_SHOWER.description: Comet Shower deals damage to all other Pokémon on the field and has a 25% chance to make each one flinch.

BIG_BANG.description: Big Bang deals damage and has a 50% chance of inflicting either burning, paralyzing, or freezing the target. (There is a 50% chance that a status condition will be inflicted, and if that occurs, each status has a 33% chance of occurring)

ACHILLES_HEEL.description: The user identifies a weaknesses in its target, dealing Super Effective damage to all that are not immune to this move.

ANCIENT_ROAR.description: The user's voice shakes with a primal roar, damaging its foes with pure fear.

CORRODE.description: Corrode deals damage and has no secondary effect. If used on Steel type Pokémon, this move ignores the type effectiveness of this move's type against Steel and treats it as being super effective against Steel types instead (even during Inverse Battles or if Corrode's type is changed). If Corrode's type is already super effective against Steel (due to being an Inverse Battle or if Corrode's type is changed), it will still only be 2× effective against Steel. The type effectiveness of Corrode's type against any other types the target has is determined normally.

CRYSTAL_RUSH.description: The user turns to solid crystal, hitting first.

DARK_MATTER.description: Dark Matter inflicts damage. A recharge turn is required on the turn after damage is done, during which no action may be performed.

DARK_NOVA.description:
Dark Nova inflicts damage, hitting the target twice per use.
Dark Nova compares the user's Attack and Special Attack stats, dealing damage to the target using the higher stat. If the user's Attack is greater than its Special Attack, the move will be a physical move; if its Special Attack is equal to or greater than its Attack, it will remain a special move.
Like other Burst Attacks, this move can only be used when Shadow Mewtwo is in Burst Mode. This move can only be used once during a single Burst Mode duration, however they can be used again upon exiting and then reentering Burst Mode. Additionally, the moves Counter, Mirror Coat, and Metal Burst cannot act in response to Burst Attacks.

DRACO_JET.description: The user uses a skill long-forgotten by the dragons to always strike first.

DRAGONIFY.description: Dragonify changes the target's type to pure Dragon; the effect lasts as long as the target is in battle, and changing form or transforming will also remove the effect.

DRAKON_VOICE.description: The sheer force of the user's voice obliterates everything in its path.

JET_STREAM.description: Jet Stream increases the priority of the user and its allies' moves by 1 during the next turn.

LIVEWIRE.description: Livewire sets an entry hazard around the target Pokémon, which will paralyze them upon switching in. It can stack up to 5 times, with each layer adding a 20% chance of incoming Pokemon being paralyzed upon switching in. This chance is doubled in the Rain.If an Electric or Ground-type Pokémon that is not also a Flying-type or has the Ability Levitate is switched in, it will absorb Livewire and the effect of Livewire will end.

LUNAR_CANNON.description: Lunar Cannon forces the user to charge on the first turn and then deals damage on the following turn. It will not need a turn to charge if used during a New Moon.

MEDUSA_RAY.description: The user glares and petrifies the foe, making them Rock-type.

MORPH.description: Morph functions the same as Transform; however, if a Delta species of the target exists, the user will turn into that instead. If the target has multiple Delta Species, it will select one of them at random.

NANOREPAIR.description: Nanorepair restores up to 50% of the user's maximum HP and increases the user's Defense by 1 stage. The Defense boost is applied even if the user's current HP is already equal to its maximum HP.

NEW_MOON.description: When New Moon is used, darkness will begin to cover the field. This effect will last for 5 turns; if the user is holding a Dark Rock, the duration is increased to 8 turns.

PERMAFROST.description:
Permafrost sets an entry hazard around the target Pokémon, which will Freeze them upon switching in. It can stack up to 5 times, with each layer adding a 10% chance of incoming Pokemon being frozen upon switching in. This chance is doubled under Hail.
Permafrost has no effect against Flying-type, Ice-type, or Fire-type Pokémon or Pokémon with the Ability Levitate or Leaf Guard (during intense sunlight). If an Ice-type or Fire-type Pokémon that is not also a Flying-type or has the Ability Levitate is switched in, it will absorb Permafrost and the effect of Permafrost will end.

RETROGRADE.description: Retrograde reverts Mega Evolved Pokémon back to their base form.

SPIRIT_AWAY.description: On the turn it is selected, Spirit Away takes the target away. While away, the target cannot act. While away, both the user and the target avoid any move targeted at them. The next turn, the target is brought back and receives damage. Spirit Away will fail if the target is behind a substitute, or if used on a target that is already semi-invulnerable due to moves such as Fly, Bounce, Sky Drop, or another Spirit Away.

WILDFIRE.description: Burns the foe. If it is a Grass-type Pokemon, burns all Pokemon in their party weak to fire.

WORMHOLE.description: The user rips a hole in space- always striking first.

ZOMBIE_STRIKE.description: The user thrusts with a ghostly arm, striking the opponent with a physical presence.

SCORCHED_ASHES.description: Sets up an entry hazard that lowers opponent's attack upon Entry

HAWTHORNS.description: The user creates a field of Hawthorns below its feet, regenerating its own health and that of its allies for each turn.

BENEVOLENCE.description: The user generates an invigorating aura which boosts your allies' heals for a maximum of 6 turns.

SUGAR_RUSH.description: The user ate tons of sweets and then rushes the target. This also damages the user quite a lot.

FLAVOR_TEST.description: The user dashes on its enemy trying to taste it like a sweet. Recovers some of the user's health. It's also an Ice type move.

DRAGON_BEAT.description: Dragon Beat does damage and has 40% chance of sharply raising the target's Attack stat.

PSYCHO_PUNCH.description: This move causes damage and has a 10% chance of confusing the target.

PSYGATLING.description: This move inflicts damage, but also has a 30% chance of burning the user.

Raid does damage and has 20% chance to:

burn the target in sunlight.
paralyze the target in rain.
poison the target in a sandstorm.
freeze the target in hail.

RAPID_GROWTH.description: The user grows rapidly in size and attacks the target. This might raise the user's Special Attack.

RAZE_EARTH.description: After this move causes damage, the user takes recoil damage by 25% the amount of damage the target took.

ROCK_TUMBLE.description: This move will repeat for up to 5 turns, increasing power every turn for every successful hit in a row.

SANDBLAST.description: This move causes damage and has a 30% chance of lowering the target's Accuracy stat by one stage.

SHADOW_CLAMP.description: A persistent bite. May also inflict confusion or sleep to the target.

SHINE_BOMB.description: This move causes damage and has a 10% chance of lowering the target's Accuracy stat by one stage.

TOXIN_SPRAY.description: This move causes damage and has a 30% chance of poisoning the target.

TYPHOON_DENEB.description:
Typhoon does damage and has a 70% chance to do each of the following:
Sharply raise the user's Defense.
Harshly lower the user'sSp.Atk.

VENGEANCE.description: The user moves last on the turn when using this move. If the target already damaged the user on the same turn, Vengeance has its power doubled to 120.

ANGRY_SWARM.description: Can confuse the foe or lower its accuracy

AQUA_SLAM.description: It has a 30% chance of lowering the target's Speed stat by one stage.

BALANCE_SEAL.description: The user attacks with a seal of light which prevents the target from using the move it last used for four turns.

BATTLE_CRY.description: The user screams out a battle cry, raising the Attack stat of any adjacent ally Pokémon.

BUG_BOMB.description: Bug Bomb inflicts damage and has a 30% chance of paralyzing.

CRACKLE_SLAM.description: Crackle Slam has a 10% Chance to flinch the target.

DARK_MATTER_SOLAR_LIGHT_LUNAR_DARK.description: Dark Matter inflicts damage and is unaffected by modifications to the accuracy stat and evasion stat. It will not hit a Pokémon during the semi-invulnerable turn of moves such as Dig, Dive, and Fly

DIAMOND_CLAW.description: The target is raked with claws as hard as diamond. Inflicts damage, that raises the user's Defence moves.

DRAGON_HIDE.description: Raises the users Defense by two stages and Special Defense by one stage.

DRAGON_IMPACT.description: The user charges at the target with great force. Inflicts damage, and lowers the user's Attack and Defense.

DRAGONIC_BLOOM.description: The user bombards the opponent with petals split away from its body. This move is Dragon and Grass type simultaneously.

DRAGONIC_FLARE.description: The user releases a powerful blast of heat from its body. This move is Dragon and Fire type simultaneously.

DRAGONIC_GLOW.description: The user unleashes arrows of light from its body. This move is Dragon and Fairy type simultaneously.

DRAGONIC_STRIKE.description: The user strikes the target with powerful electricity from its body. This move is Dragon and Electric type simultaneously.

DRAGONIC_WAVE.description: The user forces a wave of energy at the target. This move is Dragon and Water type simultaneously.

DRY_ICE.description: The target is hit with a piece of dry ice. It may also burn or freeze the target.

DUSTY_DASH.description: The user rushes along the ground, stirring up a dust cloud and attacks the target. It may also lower the target's Accuracy

ELECTROKINESIS.description: The user uses its electrostatic telepathy on the target, the user's Electric-type moves will always hit for 5 turns.

FEVER.description: The user infects the oppponent with a blast of pathogen. It may also burn the target.

FEY_HAMMER.description: The user delivers a crushing blow infused with mystical energy.

FIREWORKS.description: Fireworks deals damage and has a 10% chance of paralyzing the foe. If used on a Flying-type Pokémon, this move ignores the type effectiveness of this move's type against Flying and treats it as being super effective against Flying types instead. The type effectiveness of Fireworks against any other types the target has is determined normally.

FLARE_UP.description: The user flares its body, which changes its Normal-type moves to Fire-type moves.

FROST_CLAW.description:
Frost Claw does nothing on the turn it is selected, other than state that the user has taken in cold air. On the following turn, Frost Claw will inflict damage, PP will be deducted from it, and it will count as the last move used. Once Frost Claw is selected, the user will not be able to switch out until it is disrupted or fully executed.
Frost Claw will not need a turn to charge if used under Hail. It will only deal half of its normal damage if used during Harsh Sunlight, Rain or Sandstorm.

GALE_RUSH.description: Has a 30% Chance of Flinching the target.

GEOSPHERE.description: Geo-Sphere inflicts damage. It ignores the target's immunity to Ground-type moves (such as Flying-type Pokémon, Pokémon with Levitate or affected by Telekinesis or Magnet Rise, etc.).

GEODE_CANNON.description: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of geodes.

GHASTLY_WAIL.description: The user lets out a terrifying shriek, damaging every Pokémon around it.

GLACIER_CRASH.description: The user sets off a glacier that crashes into every Pokémon around it.

JEWEL_FLASH.description: The user attacks by shooting flashes of jewels at opposing team. It may also lower the target's accuracy.

LEAF_DARTS.description:
Each of Leaf Darts hit has a separate accuracy check. If any hit fails, the move ends.
Since each hit has 90% base accuracy, there is a 72.9% chance that it will hit 3 times (for cumulative 60 base power), an 8.1% chance that it will hit twice (for cumulative 30 base power), a 9% chance that it will hit once (for 10 base power), and a 10% chance that it will miss outright. With all three accuracy checks and base powers taken into account, the move's effective power is 47.07.
If the target has an Ability that activates upon contact, each strike counts individually, enabling the Ability to activate multiple times.
Leaf Darts may now continue attacking after breaking a substitute. If the user is holding a King's Rock or Razor Fang, each consecutive hit has an equal chance to cause the opponent to flinch.

LIGHT_BURST.description: The user creates a light ball above it, which explodes and releases beams at the target. It also lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

LIGHTNING_STRIKE.typeOverwrite: lightning Strike does damage and has a 10% chance of confusing the target.

MEGALO_FANG.description: The user tears apart the target with its sharp fangs. It may also make the target flinch.

MESMER_SMOKE.description: All Pokémon around the user are attacked with smoke that makes them sleep.

MIDNIGHT_TERRAIN.description: The user covers the ground under everyone's feet with darkness for five turns. This lowers the Accuracy of non-Dark or Ghost-type Pokémon.

MIND_BLAST.description: A strong mental blast hits the targets mind. It may also cause confusion.

MYSTIC_WAVE.description: The user stirs up a mystic wave, reducing one of the target's stats.

PHANTOM_GRIP.description: Has a 100% Chance of lowering the targets Speed by one Stage.

PLAY_FIGHT.description: The user tussles with the target. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.

RAZOR_BLADE.description: It deals damage and has a high critical hit ratio, similarly to Leaf Blade, as they have the same base power, and same effects.

SHATTER_GEM.description: The user shatters the gem it holds to unleash a great light. The type of the move changes depending on the held Gem

SHINING_TERRAIN.description: The user covers the ground under everyone's feet with solar flares for five turns. This hurts grounded non-Fire-type Pokémon.

SIPHON_BITE.description: An energy-draining bite. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

SOLAR_CLAW.description:
Solar Claw does nothing on the turn it is selected, other than state that the user has taken in sunlight. On the following turn, Solar Claw will inflict damage, PP will be deducted from it, and it will count as the last move used. Once Solar Claw is selected, the user will not be able to switch out until it is disrupted or fully executed.
Solar Claw will not need a turn to charge if used under Harsh Sunlight. It will only deal half of its normal damage if used during Rain, Sandstorm or Hail.

SOLAR_FLARE.description: The target is enveloped in a great sphere of flame. Forces the target to keep using the same move for three turns.

SQUALL_BLOW.description: The user whips up cyclones towards both opponents. This hits both opponents in Double Battles.

SULFURIC_SPRAY.description: The user sprays the target. This attack ignores Steel-type's immunity to Poison-type.

TALON_GASH.description: Talon Gash hits twice in a row. Both hits calculate damage separately and each hit can get a critical hit.

TIKI_TORCH.description: Inflicts damage, and has a 50% chance of burning.

TRICK_SHOT.description: The user distracts the target, then shoot them with small rocks or other pellets. This may also make the target flinch.

ATOMIC_PUNCH.description: Atomic Punch deals damage and has a 15% chance of paralyzing the target.

CORAL_BREAK.description: Despite being a Special move, Coral Break uses the target's Defense to calculate damage.

DRAIN_LIFE.description:
Drain Life heals the user for half the damage it deals (rounded down), unless the target has the Liquid Ooze ability, in which case the user will lose health instead.
If it is used against a substitute Drain Life will heal the user when damaging it.
Drain Life cannot be used if the user is under the effects of Heal Block.

EXPUNGE.description:
Expunge deals damage and is super effective against Nuclear-type Pokémon. However, non-Nuclear Pokémon may call it using Nature Power in irradiated areas.
Its accuracy increases to 100% during Nuclear Fallout.

FALLOUT.description: Fallout summons a Nuclear Fallout onto the field for five turns, dealing damage every odd-numbered turn to all Pokémon except Nuclear- and Steel-types.

FISSION_BURST.description: Fission Burst deals damage and causes the user to faint.

FLAME_IMPACT.description: The user tackles the target at high temps gained by air friction. This attack always goes first.

GAMMA_RAY.description: Gamma Ray deals damage and has no secondary effects.

GEMSTONE_GLIMMER.description: Gemstone Glimmer deals damage and has a 25% chance of lowering the foe’s accuracy.

GET_LUCKY.description: Get Lucky deals damage and then raises the user's critical hit rate by two stages.

GOLDEN_FIST.description:
Golden Fist inflicts damage to the target and scatters coins that are to be picked up by the player at the end of the battle, indicated by the text "Player picked up xxxx$! The amount of money picked up is equal to five times the user's level.
This attack can be used multiple times, with each additional attack adding to the total money collected at the end of the battle.
The money yielded by this attack is affected by Amulet Coin.

HALFLIFE.description: Half-Life deals damage equal to half the target's current HP and has no secondary effect. Half-Life will cause the target to faint if it only has 1 HP left.

INFERNAL_BLADE.description: If used on a Fairy-type target that would usually resist a Fire-type move due to their typing, such as Luxelong or Syrentide, Infernal Blade will ignore their other type and still hit for super-effective damage.

INSTANT_CRUSH.description: Instant Crush is a damage-dealing Psychic-type move; it inflicts damage and is an increased priority move.

LASER_PULSE.description: Although displayed as a Normal-type move, the effective typing of Laser Pulse is selected randomly between Fire, Ice, and Electric. Laser Pulse is therefore never affected by type-changing Abilities like Pixilate, Energizate or Atomizate, and the effects of moves like Ion Deluge.

METAL_CRUNCHER.description: Metal Cruncher deals damage to the target and has an 85% chance of lowering the target's defense by one stage.

METAL_WHIP.description: Metal Whip partially traps the target and deals 1/16 of the targets HP at the end of each turn. If a Binding Band is held by the user, the damage done at the end of each turn will increase from 1/16 of the target's maximum HP to 1/8. If the target uses Rapid Spin, it will be freed.

NUCLEAR_SLASH.description: Nuclear Slash deals damage and has a high critical hit rate.

NUCLEAR_WASTE.description: Nuclear Waste badly poisons the target. This move bypasses Lead Skin's immunity to Nuclear-type moves

NUCLEAR_WIND.description: Nuclear Wind deals damage and has a 5% chance of summoning Nuclear Fallout onto the field.

OCEANS_WRATH.description: Traps foes in a giant whirlpool for four to five turns.

PROTON_BEAM.description: Proton Beam deals damage and lowers the user's Special Attack by two stages.

QUANTUM_LEAP.description: Quantum Leap causes the user to vanish on the turn it is used, making it semi-invulnerable. It will return to the field the next turn, dealing damage to the target.

RADIOACID.description: Radioacid deals damage and has a 30% chance to burn the target.

SKY_FALL.description: Sky Fall deals damage and has a 30% chance of paralyzing the target.

STICKY_TERRAIN.description: The user makes the ground all slimy and gooey for five turns. Priority attacks won't work.

SUBDUCTION.description: Subduction deals damage, then lowers the target's speed by 2 stages and confuses the user.

SUDDEN_STRIKE.description: It deals damage and is an increased priority move.

THUNDERSTORM.description: Thunderstorm summons a Thunderstorm onto the field for five turns

ABYSSAL_LURE.description: Sharply raise Sp. Atk on KO

AUDACITY.description: User faints in 3 turns. +2 Atk and Speed, +6 Evasion.

FANG_BARRAGE.description: Inflicts damage equal to the target's current HP

GEOSPLINTER.description: Priority +3, Switches Atk and Def stats

HIVEMIND.description: SpA damage on Foe's Defense stat

KNIGHT_S_VOW.description: Heals party of any status effects

MIRE_SURGE.description: 50% chance of lowering the target's Speed by one stage

RIPEN.description: Increases the User's Defense by one stage, increases the user's Special Attack by two stages

SWINDLE.description: Steals money from the opposing trainer

TOXIFUME.description: Increases the User's Special Attack the first turn, the second turn it deals damage and poisons the target

TWIRLENADE.description: Increases the User's Evasion by one stage, increases the user's Speed by two stages. Confuses the User

VEILED_SKY.description: Summons an eclipse that blackens the field

DRACO_BARRAGE.description: This attack beats fairy immunities but hurts the user. Changes split based off which is stronger.

FROST_RUSH.description: This move has a 10% chance for the following secondary effect: Causes the target to flinch.

FREEZING_WATER.description: Decreases the target's Attack by 1 stage.

FAIRY_RUSH.description: This move has a 20% chance for the following secondary effect: Causes the target to flinch. Inflicts double damage and has perfect accuracy if the target is Minimized.

POLTERVENOM.description: This move has a 30% chance for the following secondary effect: Poisons the target.

TURBO_DRIVE.description: This move has a 30% chance for the following secondary effect: Paralyzes the target.

BULLET_SWING.description:
Base power depends on the calculation of (user's Speed / target's Speed), rounded down. The power is then:
(Result is 4 or greater) - 150.
(Result is 3) - 120.
(Result is 2) - 80.
(Result is 1) - 60.
(Result is less than 1) - 40.

BLOOD_MOON_LOCKEMON.description: This move sets weather Blood Moon

DUST_STORM.description: This move creates a Dust Storm

ADAMANT_WING.description: Hits twice, then deals an extra hit at +2, +4, and +6 stat stages in Defense, for a maximum of 5 hits. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. Its number of hits is unaffected by Loaded Dice or Skill Link.

AMBER_HAMMER.description: Lowers the user's Speed by 1 stage. Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

APEX_BEAM.description: The user spends three turns locked into this move. This move targets an opponent at random on each turn. If this move is successful, it breaks through the target's Detect, Protect, or Spiky Shield for this turn, allowing other Pokemon to attack the target normally. If the target's side is protected by Crafty Shield, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard, that protection is also broken for this turn and other Pokemon may attack the target's side normally. If the user is prevented from moving or the attack is not successful against the target during one of the turns, the effect ends. This move fails if used under Gravity.

CALLING_CARD.description: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Raises the user's accuracy by 1 stage on the first turn. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn. If this attack was successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held item if the user is not holding one. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

CLAY_PULSE.description: Damage is calculated using the user's Defense stat as its Special Attack, including stat stage changes. Other effects that modify the Special Attack stat are used as normal.

CRYSTAL_CURE.description: Restores 25% and any non-volatile status from the target, lowers their Speed by one stage.

DUST_KICK.description: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

ECHOLOCATE.description: Raises the user's Special Attack and accuracy by 1 stage.

FIXIT_FLURRY.description: Resets all of the target's stat stages to 0.

FULL_MOONSAULT.description: Summons Gravity for 3 turns upon use. Additional effect will not trigger if Gravity is already in effect.

HEAT_SLASH.description: This move has a 10% chance to burn the target and a higher chance for a critical hit. It will thaw out the user if it is frozen, and then inflict damage on the target.

NIGHT_PARADE.description: Deals damage to the target based on its Defense instead of Special Defense.

PUFF_UP.description: Power doubles with each successful hit, up to a maximum of 160 power. The power is reset if this move misses or another move is used.

ROULETTE.description:
Rolls a Roulette (00,0,1-36) with the following outcomes each having a 1/38 chance to occur to all Pokémon on the field:
00 	The user explodes
0 	Raises Attack by 1 stage
1 	Lowers Attack by 1 stage
2 	Raises Defense by 1 stage
3 	Lowers Defense by 1 stage
4 	Raises Sp. Atk by 1 stage
5 	Lowers Sp. Atk by 1 stage
6 	Raises Sp. Def by 1 stage
7 	Lowers Sp. Def by 1 stage
8 	Raises Speed by 1 stage
9 	Lowers Speed by 1 stage
10 	Raises Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed by 1 stage
11 	Lowers Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed by 1 stage
12 	Raises critical-hit rate by 2 stages
13 	Inflicts burn
14 	Inflicts poison
15 	Inflicts paralysis
16 	Inflicts confusion
17 	Sets Stealth Rock
18 	Sets Spikes
19 	Sets Toxic Spikes
20 	Sets Sticky Web
21 	Summons Sunny Day
22 	Summons Rain Dance
23 	Summons Snowscape
24 	Summons Sandstorm
25 	Summons Grassy Terrain
26 	Summons Electric Terrain
27 	Summons Misty Terrain
28 	Summons Psychic Terrain
29 	Summons Toxic Terrain
30 	Summons Trick Room
31 	Summons Gravity
32 	Applies Defog's effect to the field
33 	Applies Court Change's effect
34 	Applies Substitute's effect to all battlers
35 	Applies Pain Split's effect to all battlers
36 	Applies Perish Song's effect to all battlers

Regular immunities apply in all cases.

RUNE_POWER.description: This move's type is changed from Rock to whatever the Pokémon's primary Type is. If the Pokémon is somehow Typeless, it reverts to Rock-type. This move becomes a physical attack if the user's Attack is greater than its Special Attack, including stat stage changes. As a result of its function, it always has STAB.

SCRAP_SHOT.description: The move starts at 40 base power, adding another 40 for each layer of entry hazard on the user's side of the field, up to a max of 320 base power with three layers of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web and two layers of Toxic Spikes. The hazards are then removed after the move's execution.

SIREN_SONG.description: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Chilly Reception, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. If the target leaves the field using Baton Pass, the replacement will remain trapped. The effect ends if the user leaves the field.

THORN_FALL.description: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

TOXIC_TERRAIN.description: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Toxic Terrain. During the effect, the power of Poison-type attacks used by grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 1.3, and grounded Pokemon are prevented from restoring any HP. Nature Power becomes Sludge Bomb and Terrain Pulse doubles in power and becomes Poison type. Fails if the current terrain is Toxic Terrain.

TRASH_TALK.description: Power doubles if the target's last used move, including moves called by other moves or those used through Magic Coat, or the Magic Bounce Ability, failed to do any of its normal effects, not including damage from an unsuccessful High Jump Kick, or if the target was prevented from moving by any effect other than recharging. A move that was blocked by Detect, Protect, Spiky Shield, Crafty Shield, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard will not double this move's power, nor will Bounce or Fly ending early due to the effect of Gravity or Smack Down.

UPROOT.description: If both the user and the target have not fainted, the target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. This effect ignores Ingrain and Suction Cups but still fails if this move hit a Substitute.

VOID_BURST.description: Hits two to five times. Has a 10% chance to confuse the target per hit. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit fives times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move has an even chance to hit four or five times.

WRANGLE.description: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Chilly Reception, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Rapid Spin, Wriggle or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

WRIGGLE.description: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the effects of binding and trapping moves end for the user. It does not clear hazards.

SWOOP.description: Swoop inflicts damage and has a 30% chance of causing the target to flinch.

MESMERIZE.description: Mesmerize puts the target to sleep. Mesmerize cannot affect targets with Insomnia, Vital Spirit or Sap Sipper as their Ability.

TRANSPIRATION.description: When Transpiration is used, rainfall will start on the field which will last for five turns. (If the user is holding a Damp Rock this will last for eight turns.) If it is already raining Transpiration will fail. It also heals the user by 1/4 of their total HP when used.

KAOLIN_BASH.description: A bash coated in fresh clay deals damage. Water Types are dried up and take super-effective damage.

DIAMONDBREATH.description: Opposing Pokemon are blasted with rare ores. This may lower the target's Special Defense.

IRON_BARB.description: The target is struck with a sharp object.

IRON_STRIKE.description: The user gives a harsh strike with its tail, knocking out its target drastically increases Attack stat.

FROST_WALKER.description: The user cloaks itself in ice and attacks. Building up more power, it raises the user's Speed stat. It can be used to freeze water to traverse it.

PRIMAL_SUN.description: The user maximizes its Special Attack stat in exchange for HP equal to half its max HP.

SHADOW_STEP.description: The user swiftly strikes its target. It is sure to strike first.

FANG_LEECH.description: A life-stealing attack. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

WAVE_LASH.description: The user slashes the target with water.

FIRECRACKERS.description: The target is attacked with small exploding flames. It may leave the target burned.

SWIFT_STRIKE.description: The user swiftly strikes its target. It is sure to strike first.

HEATED_REV_UP.description: By heating up, the user's Atk, Spatk and Speed are sharply raised. Only works the first turn.

NIGHT_SHADE_BOUQUET.description: A bouquet filled with nightshades is thrown at the target, dealing damage and leaving a layer of toxic spikes.

WHIRLY_HELIX.description: A mighty gale storms the opponent. It does more damage the faster the user is.

VINDUNAR.description: Mystical wind attack the target. Uses highest attack stat and never misses under Rain.

CODE_INJECTION.description: By editing the enemy's data, a virus is injected. This may also lower the target's Sp.Defense.

FILTHY_TERRAIN.description: The user makes the ground under everyone's feet turn filthy, boosting Poison-type moves and intensifying poison damage.

BOILING_SHOWER.description: The user showers the target with bubbling hot water. This may also leave the target with a burn.

SHARP_CUT.description: The user makes sure to strike the target's weak point. This attack always results in a critical hit.

DOWNPOUR.description: The user bombards the target from above with an immeasurable amount of water. The attack's recoil harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.

SAND_WAVE.description: The user attacks with a wave that crawls along the ground. Those hit can't flee from battle.

SKY_DIVE.description: The user dives down from the sky onto the target at incredible speed. This can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

LOVE_LARIAT.description: The target is squeezed tightly. This attack does massive damage to a target that is infatuated.

GOLD_BREAKER.description: The user slams the target with two arms of solid gold. Money is earned after the battle.

ACCELVOLT.description:
When it is used, it does a turn check based on the user's Speed and the opponent's Speed.
If the opponent is faster, the user's Speed is raised by 1 stage.
If the user is faster, Special Attack is raised by 1 stage.
If your opponent uses a priority damage dealing move, the user's Speed is raised.
If Prankster or Gale Wings is used to outspeed, the user's Speed is raised by 1 Stage.

AROMA_WIND.description: 10% chance to inflict Confusion or Sleep on (targets multiple opponents).

LUSTER_BLOOM.description: It is a move with 80 BP, 100 acc, 10 PP, and of the Special category, and has a 10% chance to reduce the foe's accuracy.

BOLD_BLAZE.description: If the target's HP is half or less, this attack will hit with double the power (so in other words, it is a Fire-type clone of Brine).

TERRAFIRM.description: It is a Curse clone (without the Ghost effect), buffing the user's Atk/Def while lowering Spe.

SOIL_THROW.description: 100% chance to lower the target's Defense.

REGAL_FANG.description: Regal Fang bypasses Flying-type Immunity, including Levitate, and deals damage. Unlike Thousand Arrows, Regal Fang does not ground the opponent to be susceptible to Ground-type moves.

WARBLE.description: It is a status-category move that lowers the target's Special Defense by a stage.

GLORY_WING.description: It is Special category, 95 BP, 100 acc and 15 PP, with a chance to raise the user's Special Attack.

HAIRPIN_TURN.description: It is a move that increases the user's Speed and Evasion by a single stage.

QUICK_TURN.description: It has 70 BP, 100 Accuracy, 15 PP and is of the Physical category.

MYSTIC_CHANT.description: is guaranteed to hit the opponent as long as they are not in a semi-invulnerable state, such as when using Fly.

EXSANGUINATE.description: Exsanguinate is basically Dark-type Giga Drain with the same effect of healing up to 50% of the damage dealt to the target.

CRYOSHOCK.description: It is of the Physical category with 85 Power, 100% Accuracy and 15 PP that has a 10% chance of inflicting frozen status to the target.

BLACK_HOLE.description: Black Hole is basically a Dark type Draco Meteor/Overheat/Leaf Storm variant with the same stats and downside of dropping Special Attack by 2 Stages.

ROCKET_DRIVE.description: Rocket Drive is basically Steel-type Wild Charge with the same drawback: Deals recoil equal to 25% of the damage done to the target.

SHADOW_SPLIT.description: 10% chance to make the target flinch.

HARD_KNOCK.description: Hard Knock inflicts damage, but it uses the user's Defense stat instead of its Attack stat to calculate damage

SPEEDMITE.description: It is quite literally, an Accelerock clone.

NEUROTOXIN.description: inflicts poison or paralysis status to the target.

WINDMILL.description:
It has the unique property of changing category depending on the Pokemon that has it (for example, it is Physical on Fruitius, but Special on Fūpyan). It is not determined by IVs, PV * or any other hidden factor. Physical: 20% chance to raise user's Speed.
Special: 20% chance to lower Target's Speed and raise user's Speed.

ASTROFORCE.description: has a 10% chance of raising all of the user's stats by one stage.

TERRAHEDRON.description: 40% chance of raising the target's Special Attack by 2 stages.

CHROME_BALL.description: It has a 20% chance to drop the foe's Sp Def.

MARVEL_TRICK.description: Marvel Trick switches the user's raw Special Attack stat with its raw Special Defense stat. Stat modifiers are not swapped. The effect of Marvel Trick may be Baton Passed to swap the recipient's stats. Using Marvel Trick again will swap the user's stats again, but will not prevent Baton Pass from passing the effect.

ENGORGE.description: Engorge deals damage to a target.

ELECTROBASH.description: Electrobash has a 20% chance to inflict paralysis.

AQUA_IMPACT.description: Aqua Impact is basically Wave Crash with the same drawback: Deals recoil to user equal to 1/3 of the damage done to target

GRIM_RANCOR.description: Grim Rancor has a 30% chance to paralyze the opponent. Grim Rancor cannot paralyze Electric-type Pokemon

TITANIC_HORN.description: Titanic Horn is basically Steel type Megahorn.

PRISM_ATTACK.description: It has a unique mechanic where the move is not Normal, but in fact is based on the primary type of the user.

GRIMEBUSTER.description: It is a physical version of Overheat, sharply reducing the Attack stat by two stages when used.

PHEROTOXIN.description: 100% chance to Poison the Target and possibly Infatuate the target as well.

ROYAL_BREATH.description: Royal Breath deals damage and has a 10% chance of raising the user's Special Attack by one stage.

DYNASWORD.description: If the user's previous move was Hone Claws, Dynasword's Base Power will be twice the base power. If its next move is not Dynasword or a non-damaging move, the doubled base power wears off without being used.

ICE_ENTOMB.description: inflicts frozen status to the target

PROBE_PUNCH.description: has a 10% chance to lower the target's defense.

SOULSHOCK.description: If target's HP is below 50%, this move deals double damage.

STRETCH.description: increases the user's Attack, Speed, and Evasion by 1 stage.

SOMNISMOG.description: 60% chance of putting the opponent to sleep.

MOON_IMPACT.description: Moon Impact is Fairy type Head Smash with the same drawback: Deals recoil to user equal to 1/2 of the damage done to target.

ZENITH_BREAK.description: Zenith Break is a souped up version of Superpower by sacrificing type effectiveness against 5 types to 1 type effectiveness (Dragon) that happens to have only 2 types that resist Dragon (Fairy and Steel) in exchange for +20 Power.

HEARTFELT_PULSE.description: The user gathers its love into a burst of energy that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

MALICE_STRIKE.description: The target is struck with all the frustrations of the user. This may also make the target flinch.

COLD_SNAP.description: The user drops air temperature around the target to inflict freeze.

LANDSLIDE.description: The power of this attack move is doubled if the user has been hurt by the target in the same turn.

BOLT_IN.description: The user crashes into its target while running around aimlessly. Hitting a target raises the Speed stat.

SAND_SHOT.description: The user hurls sand at the target. This may also lower the target's accuracy.

NATURE_S_CALL.description: All Pokémon on the field are forced to answer Nature's call, and have to switch out. In the wild, this ends a battle.

FLURRY_PECK.description: The user pecks the target repeatedly two to five times in a row.

DRAGON_FANG.description: The user bites the target, rousing itself with power. This may also make the target flinch or raise the user's Attack stat.

FEATHER_SLASH.description: The user slashes and cuts the target with its feathers. Critical hits land more easily.

PINCH.description: The target is trapped and squeezed continuously by the user's claws or pincers for four to five turns.

FLYTRAP_FANG.description: The user tries to gobble up its target, restoring HP by half the damage taken by the target. This move is super effective on Bug types.

FACEPLANT.description: The user grows roots or vines to slam the target into the ground with great force. The target takes additional damage from any traps set around its feet.

BURNING_SNEEZE.description: The user attacks by shooting flaming snot at the target. This may also leave the target poisoned or with a burn.

LIGHT_UP.description: The user brightens up like a flame to boost its Sp. Atk stat and accuracy.

SPIRIT_FLAME.description: The target is scorched with ghastly fire. This move is Ghost and Fire type simultaneously.

ORCHARD_S_EMBRACE.description: The user's roots dig deep into the earth, borrowing strength from any trees to boost its Defense and Sp. Def stats. The stats are raised sharply on Grassy Terrain.

PIXIE_DUST.description: The user sprinkles mysterious dust on the target to inflict either confusion, paralysis, or sleep.

RAINBOW_GUST.description: The user whips out a multicolored gust of wind to hit opposing Pokémon. It may also raise all the user's stats at once.

SWEET_DECAY.description: The user attacks with a concentrated blast of sugar that rots the target's teeth, preventing it from using biting moves for two turns.

THUNDER_TAIL.description: The user strikes the target with an electrically charged tail. Critical hits land more easily.

ELECTROCUTE.description: The user electrocutes the opponent by releasing colorful sparks. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

SOLID_KICK.description: The user attacks the target with a sturdy kick.

FEATHER_RUSH.description: The user charges the target in a ball of feathers. However, this also lowers the user's Attack and Defense stats.

LEAF_TURN.description: The user slaps the target using the leaves on its body.

VERDANT_TAIL.description: The target is struck with a tail charged with natural energy. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

ROYAL_DECREE.description: For five turns, the user prevents the opposing team from raising their stats.

BATTLE_ROAR.description: The user lets out a fearsome battle cry. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.

THREAD_LASH.description: The user whips the target with sticky threads twice. This may also lower the target's Speed stat.

TORPEDO_DASH.description: The user propels itself at the target like a torpedo. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.

POISON_BURST.description: The user releases an explosion of flaming acids. This may also leave the target with a burn.

PSI_BULLET.description: The user fires a bullet of concentrated psychic energy. This attack always results in a critical hit.

WATER_ARROW.description: The user fires an arrow made of water at the target. Critical hits land more easily.

SINGE.description: The target is attacked with small but hot flames. This may also leave the target with a burn.

HAPPY_SLAP.description: The user pounds the target with joy.

SQUALL.description: The user whips up a gust of cool air at the opposing Pokémon, which summons a heavy rain that falls for two turns.

SEED_SHOT.description: The user shoots a seed at the target to inflict damage.

CHIRP.description: The user chirps loudly, lowering the Attack of opposing Pokémon.

BANANARANG.description: The user throws a banana at the target, which loops around to hit the target twice—coming and going.

FRUIT_MUNCH.description: The user eats its held Berry, then restores its own HP by up to half of its max HP.

SOUL_CHOMP.description: The user phases through the target's body while rending its spirit. This attack deals special damage.

FLAME_POUNCE.description: A physical attack in which the user leaps foward and smacks the target with its warmed-up body.

REEF_BARRIER.description: The user redirects moves targeting Water-type allies to itself. Taking damage for an ally raises the Defense and Sp. Def stats.

HONEY_BOMB.description: The user attacks by splattering balls of sweet honey at its target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

TEAM_UP.description: The user gets all party Pokémon to attack the target. The more party Pokémon, the greater the number of attacks.

BALANCED_BEAM.description: Launches a beam of equal energy that hits all foes in its path.

ICICLE_STRIKE.description: Sharp-edged icicles are launched to slash at the opposing team. Critical hits land more easily.

GLOOM.description: The foe's field is attacked with gloomy energy that may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

MANA_BLAST.description: The user attacks with stored up natural energy. Chance to drop target's Sp. Atk.

FLUX_WAVE.description: The user releases a wave of twisting energy. It may also confuse the targets.

FLEETING_BLOW.description: The user lands a fleeting blow. Always hit and will do 50% extra damage to evasive foes.

SCRAMBLE_MIND.description: The user attacks the targets by scrambling their minds. This may also confuse the target.

WYRM_S_RAGE.description: The user attacks driven by frustration. Power increases if the user's previous move failed.

BLINDING_FLASH.description: Sweeps the target with a blinding sweep of light that may also leave them stunned with paralysis.

SIGNAL_OVERLOAD.description: The user overloads the senses of everyone around it by emitting flashing lights and sounds.

COLD_FRONT.description: A cold front settles in, increasing the user's Attack and Sp. Atk stats by one stage.

SEANCE.description: Summons apparitions that hit two to five times in a row.

SPECTRAL_LASH.description: If the target's HP is down to about half, this attack will hit with double the power.

SACRED_STRIKE.description: The user strikes the target with sacred power. It may also lower the target's Defense stat.

FANATICISM.description: The user attacks with fanatical focus. Power increases if the user's previous move failed.

VANGUARD.description: The user secures itself on the field, refusing to switch out and restores its HP on every turn.

RAPTURE.description: The user attacks with a cataclysmic strike. It may also burn the foe.

BLESSED_HAMMER.description: The user throws an enchanted hammer. The hammer loops to hit the target twice coming and going.

BIRD_OF_PREY.description: The user's natural instinct is heightened, boosting its Attack stat and Accuracy by one stage.

DRACO_TEMPEST.description: If the target's HP is down to about half, this attack will hit with double the power.

AUTUMN_BLAST.description: Uses the power of autumn to remove the effects of Light Screen and Reflect.

DRENCH.description: Drenches enemy foes in a deluge of water. It may also make the targets flinch.

PRIMORDIAL_BEAM.description: The user attacks with primordial power. Chance to drop target's Sp. Atk.

METALLIC_GLEAM.description: The user's surface shines brightly on the target. It may also lower the target's accuracy.

GHASTLY_FLOOD.description: A torrent of deceased spirits engulfs the opponent. It may also lower the targets' accuracy.

TIDAL_SHIFT.description: The user manipulates the tides to its favour. It sharply boosts the Speed stat.

GRACEFUL_STRIKE.description: Strikes the target with the elegance of fairies. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

CRASHING_WAVE.description: The target is hit with a crashing wave. It may also raise the user's Attack.

RIPTIDE.description: The user surges at the target and hits with a wall of water. It may also lower the target's Attack stat.

TORRENT.description: The user blasts the target and drags out another PokÃ©mon in its party. In the wild the battle ends.

OVERFLOW.description: Floods the battlefield, raising user's Speed and removing hazards and binding moves.

STALK_PREY.description: The user hones its sight on its prey's weak points, lowering their -Def and SpDef by 1.

ENCIRCLE.description: Swoops around the foes' side of the battle, preventing them from escaping.

KAMEHAMEHA.description: Channels a large beam of energy at the foe. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def.

RADIANT_LANCE.description: The user releases its light energy in a whirl. If it misses, the user hurts itself.

ENCHANTMENT.description: The user casts an enchantment at its foe. It has a chance to raise the user's Speed stat.

PSY_BLAST.description: The user assaults the target's psyche. It may also make the target flinch.

HEX_BOLT.description: The user shoots a magical bolt at the foe that doesn't consider the foe's stat changes.

MIND_MELD.description: Makes the enemy's mind wither, making them forget how to use their held item.

WELD.description: The user welds the target, inflicting a burn.

ZEPHYR_PURGE.description: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.

ATHENA_S_WISDOM.description: The user renders the opponent helpless with Athena's wisdom. May +user's Sp. Def.

RASENGAN.description: Gathers energy into its palm to blast the foe. Has a chance to paralyze the target

OVERWHELM.description: The user overwhelms the target with its strength. It may also lower the target's Defense stat.

CHAIN_SWEEP.description: The user lashes at the target with chains, reducing its Speed stat.

KINETIC_BLAST.description: A forceful wave of natural energy is launched at the opposing team. Critical hits land more easily.

AURA_BLOCK.description: The user blocks the foe's aura, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

TUNDRA_RUSH.description: The user rushes at the enemy with cold fury. It has a chance to raise the user's Speed stat.

SEPTIC_STRIKE.description: Target is struck with an appendage or projectile. Chance to lower the target's Def.

FLAME_PILLAR.description: The user calls down a pillar of flame on the target. High Crit ratio.

PIDDLE.description: Relieves itself on an enemy, lowering its Def/SpDef by 1 stage, and then switches out.

VIBRATO.description: Launches an echoing attack at the opposing team. Critical hits land more easily.

PERCUSSION_BLAST.description: The target is hit with a percussive blast. It may also raise the user's Attack.

SUPPRESS_AURA.description: The target's aura is suppressed, allowing it to use only attack moves for three turns.

REFURBISH.description: The user refurbishes its body, boosting its highest and lowest stat.

MAGIC_PALM.description: Sends a wave of energy at the foe. Always hit and will do 50% extra damage to evasive foes.

CLACK_A_CLACK.description: The user attacks with a horrible clattering noise, also raising the user's Sp. Atk stat.

IRRITANT.description: Spits a sticky substance causing irritation at the target. 10% chance to lower Sp.Atk.

DIRGE.description: The user sings a hymn of the dead to raise its Sp. Atk and Accuracy by 1 stage.

HUNT_DOWN.description: An attack move that inflicts double damage if used on a target that is switching out of battle.

SOUL_RIP.description: The user rips into the target's soul. This attack does special damage.

DISTURB.description: Disturbs the target with terrorizing visions, making it drop their held item.

DARK_PRISM.description: The user shoots an object of sinister energy at the foe. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

SNOWBALL.description: Throws a snowball towards the target.

SPITEFUL_CHANT.description: The user recites a spiteful chant that drags out another PokÃ©mon in its party. In the wild the battle ends.

MALEFIC_ACT.description: The user attacks the foe in a manner that doesn't consider the foe's stat changes.

ARCANE_BARRAGE.description: The user wallops the target with magical blasts 2-5 times in a row. This move always goes first.

MIND_CRUSH.description: This attack's power increases the more the target has powered up with stat changes.

DRACONIC_WAVE.description: Flies into the sky and strafes the ground with mystical fire. It may also make the targets flinch.

THROWING_STAR.description: Throwing stars are launched at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.

CAUSTIC_ACID.description: The user hurls highly corrosive acid at the target. It may also cause paralysis.

ESSENCE_BLOOM.description: Flowers bloom at the feet of foes, lowering the targets' Speed stat.

DRACONIC_MIGHT.description: The user charges at the foe, taking damage but may also paralyze the target.

QUILL_VOLLEY.description: A consecutive volley of sharp feathers three times that become more powerful with each successive hit.

WINTER_S_GRASP.description: A freezing air settles in, reducing enemy foes' Speed by 2 stages.

CHILLING_BLAST.description: The user blasts the target with freezing air. KOing raises user's SpAtk sharply.

GLORIOUS_HYMN.description: Sings a magnificient hymn. The attack's recoil harshly reduces the user's Sp. Atk stat.

POLAR_PUMMEL.description: The target is hit with a pummelling of icy punches. It may also raise the user's Attack.

SLURP.description: The user slurps some of the target's blood, draining 50% of damage dealt.
